# Higgsfield remote MCP

Use the official endpoint and vendor sign-in configured through Control Center. Do not hardcode the
endpoint because vendor connection details can change. Discover tools into quarantine, map selected
tools to Ecomark creative capabilities, set credit limits, run a sandbox generation, then activate.

Inputs are signed, time-limited Media Library references. Generated outputs are imported into the
tenant Media Library and scanned before Agents can reuse them.
